note: vespera_inprocess: with the tracing feature the span's method field is one of the nine standard methods or _OTHER, never the raw client text, and the 405 body / WARN detail echo at most 64 bytes of an invalid method. DIRECT dispatch holds every response body to max_buffered_response_bytes like the buffered path (all statuses, exact-length bodies in the legacy overflow count, resumed write_into), answering the same 500. The bidirectional small-body inline pull runs only on a multi-thread runtime's block_on thread and under block_in_place, so a pull may use Tokio blocking APIs and a current-thread runtime no longer hangs. Doc fixes: dispatch timeout needs the time driver, empty app means the default app, async callback may run inline when shutdown races the call, broken intra-doc links.
